entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="あいつら、あたしたちを何だと思ってるの？ ここがコーポ・プラザにでも見える？" t="Who do they think we are? Does this look like Corpo Plaza to you?" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="あいつら、あたしたちを何だと思ってるの？ ここがコーポ・プラザにでも見える？" t="Ce cred că suntem? Ți se pare că e Corpo Plaza aici?" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: Try as I might, can't imagine that. Not even fucking close.
entries.ro: Oricât m-aș strădui, nu-mi pot imagina asta. Nici pe departe, pula mea.

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="じゃあなんでこんな堅苦しい生活をしなきゃいけないの！" t="So why do I feel like I live in goddamned Corpo Plaza?" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="じゃあなんでこんな堅苦しい生活をしなきゃいけないの！" t="Atunci de ce simt că trăiesc în nenorocitul de Corpo Plaza?" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="なにが“警備”料金よ？ クロウズの奴ら、今年に入ってもう3回も値上げしやがって！" t="Think our \"security\" fees could have something to do with it? Tygers asked for more! Again! Third time this year!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="なにが“警備”料金よ？ クロウズの奴ら、今年に入ってもう3回も値上げしやがって！" t="Crezi că taxele noastre de „securitate” au ceva de-a face cu asta? Tygers au cerut mai mult! Iar! A treia oară anul ăsta!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: Hey, hey, not so loud. Walls have ears, you don't want trouble.
entries.ro: Hei, hei, nu așa tare. Pereții au urechi, nu vrei belele.

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="あたしには小さな子供が2人と、BDアクターを目指す夫がいるの。タイガークロウズでもなんでも、かかってきなさいよ" t="I have two small kids and an aspiring BD actor for a husband. The Tyger Claws are my entertainment." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="あたしには小さな子供が2人と、BDアクターを目指す夫がいるの。タイガークロウズでもなんでも、かかってきなさいよ" t="Am doi copii mici și un soț care vrea să ajungă actor BD. Tyger Claws, nu mă sperie nimeni." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: I getcha. Still, wouldn't want those kids to lose their mother, would ya?
entries.ro: Te înțeleg. Totuși, n-ai vrea ca ăia mici să-și piardă mama, nu?
